pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā sikkhamānā thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṅkamitvā upasampadaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.4: “sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi, evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmī”ti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpeti, na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.5: atha kho sā sikkhamānā bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.8: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpessati, na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.10: “sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpeti, na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karotī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.14: “sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmī”ti vatvā neva vuṭṭhāpessati na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:1.17.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī sikkhamānaṃ sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti vatvā pacchā sā anantarāyikinī neva vuṭṭhāpeyya na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ kareyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:2.1.7: sace me tvaṃ ayye cīvaraṃ dassasi evāhantaṃ vuṭṭhāpessāmīti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc77:2.1.15: neva vuṭṭhāpessāmi na vuṭṭhāpanāya ussukkaṃ karissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
